name: Aptabase Cloud Free
free_limit: 20,000 analytics events/month with unlimited apps, EU or US data residency, live dashboard, session timeline, CSV export and SDKs; no credit card required.
watch_out: Each track call counts as an event; no overage fees. Analytics ingestion pauses once the 20,000-event monthly quota is exceeded and resumes next month. Cloud Free differs from catalogued self-hosted Aptabase; explicit commercial-use terms are not independently confirmed.
